te.title: కడుపు నొప్పిగా ఉందా? గ్యాస్ట్రిటిస్? యాసిడ్ రిఫ్లక్స్? ఈ కొరియన్ హీలింగ్ సూప్ గంజి కంటే మెరుగ్గా ...
te.description:
ఫుడ్ సైన్స్ మేజర్ యొక్క నిజాయితీగల వంట స్థలానికి మిమ్మల్ని ఆహ్వానిస్తున్నాము ❤️.

వంట అంటే ప్రేమ!
కడుపు నొప్పి, యాసిడ్ రిఫ్లక్స్ లేదా గ్యాస్ట్రిటిస్‌తో పోరాడుతున్నారా?
ఇది నా అమ్మ నా కోసం తయారుచేసిన వైద్యం చేసే కొరియన్ సూప్ - ఇప్పుడు నేను మీతో పంచుకుంటున్నాను.
గంజి కంటే మెరుగ్గా, ఈ మ్యాజిక్ సూప్ కేవలం 10 నుండి 20 నిమిషాల్లో మీ కడుపును శాంతపరుస్తుంది.
మధుమేహ వ్యాధిగ్రస్తులకు మరియు భారీ భోజనం లేదా హ్యాంగోవర్ తర్వాత ఉపశమనం కోసం చూస్తున్న ఎవరికైనా సరైనది.

ఇది JUNTV నుండి సరళమైన, నిజాయితీగల వంటకం, ప్రేమ మరియు శ్రద్ధతో తయారు చేయబడింది.

యాసిడ్ రిఫ్లక్స్
గ్యాస్ట్రిటిస్

de.title: Pollack-Rettich-Suppe für Eltern — Nicht anbraten, sondern „das“ hinzufügen (Deutsch synchronisiert)
de.description:
Dieses Video ist vollständig auf Deutsch synchronisiert verfügbar.

Diese warme, nussige koreanische Suppe ist perfekt für den Winter – besonders für deine Eltern.
 Der getrocknete Fisch wird nicht angebraten, sondern mit einer Zutat verfeinert, die den Geschmack klarer und tiefer macht.
 Mit Rettich, Perillapulver, Brühe aus Anchovis und Frühlingszwiebeln
 ist diese Suppe reichhaltig, sättigend und voller Liebe.
 Koche sie für deine Familie zu den Feiertagen – sie wird sie lieben.
 Kochen ist Liebe.
Zutaten
 100g getrockneter Pollack
 500g Rettich
 2 Frühlingszwiebeln (ca. 200g)
 2 EL Sesamöl
 1 großes Stück Kombu
 30 große oder 50 mittlere Anchovis
 4 EL Perillapulver
 Salz nach Geschmack
Business email: juntvrecipe@gmail.com
 #weihnachtssuppe #pollack #koreanischesuppe #rettichsuppe #perilla #familienrezept #JUNTV #juntv

en.title: Dried Pollack Radish Soup for Parents — Don’t Stir-Fry, Just Add “This” | JUNTV (Dubbed in English)
en.description:
This video is available with full English dubbing.

This warm, nutty Korean soup is perfect for winter — especially for your parents.
 We don’t stir-fry the dried pollack. Instead, we add a special ingredient that brings out a deeper, cleaner flavor.
 Made with radish, perilla powder, anchovy broth, and green onion,
 this soup is rich, satisfying, and full of love.
 Make it for your family this holiday — they’ll truly appreciate it.
 Cooking is love.
Ingredients
 100g dried pollack strips
 500g Korean radish
 2 stalks green onion (about 200g)
 2 tablespoons sesame oil
 1 large piece kelp
 30 large anchovies or 50 medium anchovies
 4 tablespoons perilla powder
 Salt, to taste

fr.title: Soupe au colin séché et radis pour parents — Ne le sautez pas, ajoutez « ceci » | JUNTV (Doublé)
fr.description:
Cette vidéo est disponible avec un doublage complet en français.

Cette soupe coréenne chaude et légèrement noisettée est parfaite pour l’hiver — surtout pour vos parents.
 On ne fait pas revenir le poisson séché. On ajoute à la place un ingrédient spécial pour un bouillon plus clair et plus profond.
 Avec du radis blanc, de la poudre de périlla, un bouillon d’anchois et de la ciboule,
 cette soupe est riche, réconfortante et pleine d’amour.
 Préparez-la pour vos proches durant les fêtes — ils vous remercieront de tout cœur.
 Cuisiner, c’est aimer.
Ingrédients (4 personnes)
 100g de colin séché (pollack)
 500g de radis blanc

 2 c. à soupe d’huile de sésame

id.description:

 Kami tidak menumis ikan pollack kering. Sebagai gantinya, kami tambahkan bahan rahasia yang membuat rasa lebih dalam dan kaldu lebih jernih.
 Dengan lobak, bubuk perilla, kaldu ikan teri, dan daun bawang,
 sup ini kaya rasa, memuaskan, dan penuh kasih sayang.
 Masaklah untuk keluarga Anda saat liburan ini — mereka pasti akan menyukainya.
 Memasak adalah cinta.

snippet.description:
절임배추 평생고민 끝| 소금, 고춧가루도 반이상 줄일 수 있어요. “이걸” 넣으면  No (설탕+젓갈+msg+풀)이어도 남도김치 다신 안쳐다봐요.  #김치, #배추, #김장, #절임배추, #소금, #고춧가루, #절임배추, #준티비, #JUNTV

재료
배추절임 재료: 
고춧가루 130g (1.3%), 소금 2%  210g  (9500g * 0.02= 190g) &  다시마 큰것 1.5 장 (30-40cm)

배추양념 재료: 
생야채: 무 2kg, 배 500g 대파 2줄기, 쪽파 40줄기, 홍갓 200g  무 절임용 천일염 20g (1%)
         덖는것 : 양파 500g, 마늘 40개, 멸치 100마리. 토마토 500g, 소금 10g
         가는것 : 1차 사과 500g. 마늘 10개, 생강 3개. 우려낸 다시마 1/3개    
                      동태전감 200g
                      2차 홍고추 10개
                      3차 건고추 10개
         마지막무침: 거친고춧가루 70g  김치소 용
                            거친고춧가루 35g  김치완성용

**Ingredients for Salting Napa Cabbage:**  
- Red pepper powder: 130g (1.3%)  
- Salt: 2% - 210g (9500g * 0.02 = 190g)  
- Large kelp: 1.5 sheets (30-40cm)  

**Ingredients for Napa Cabbage Seasoning:**  
- **Fresh Vegetables:**  
  Radish: 2kg  
  Pear: 500g  
  Green onion: 2 stalks  
  Scallion: 40 stalks  
  Red mustard greens: 200g  
  Sea salt for radish salting: 20g (1%)  

- **For Roasting:**  
  Onion: 500g  
  Garlic: 40 cloves  
  Anchovies: 100 pieces  
  Tomato: 500g  
  Salt: 10g  

- **For Grinding:**  
  1st: Apple: 500g, 
          Garlic: 10 cloves, 
           Ginger: 3 pieces, 
            Soaked kelp: 1/3 sheet  
  2nd: Pollack fillet: 200g  
  3rd: Fresh red chili: 10 pieces  
  4th: Dried red chili: 10 pieces  

- **Final Mixing:**  
  Coarse red pepper powder: 70g (for kimchi filling)  
  Coarse red pepper powder: 35g (for final kimchi preparation)

en.title: JUNTV | Master Kimchi at Home: No Fermented Seafood & Rich Flavor! (Dubbed in English)
en.description:
This video is dubbed in English for your convenience.
Craving delicious, homemade kimchi but want to avoid fermented seafood? Look no further! In this video, JUNTV shares a revolutionary kimchi recipe that achieves incredible depth, sweetness, and umami without a single drop of fermented seafood. You won't believe the rich flavor!
We'll guide you through each step, from salting the cabbage with a surprisingly small amount of salt to preparing the unique, flavorful paste. Discover the secret ingredients and techniques that make this kimchi taste like a gourmet Southern-style kimchi. It's truly a game-changer!
Ingredients:
For Salting Cabbage:
3 whole cabbages (approx. 9.5 kg / 20.9 lbs)
125g (1.3%) Gochugaru (Korean chili powder)
190g (2%) Coarse salt
Kelp (for salting)
For the Kimchi Paste:
1 kg radish
500g Korean pear (or apple for substitution)
20g coarse salt (for radish)
500g tomatoes
500g onions
40 cloves garlic (approx. 4 cloves per kg of cabbage)
95 dried anchovies (approx. 10 anchovies per kg of cabbage), heads and guts removed
10g coarse salt (for drying ingredients)
2 large green onions
200g (2%) Red mustard greens
40 strands chives
500g (5%) Apples, peeled and cored
1 head garlic (approx. 1 per kg of cabbage)
3 pieces ginger (about the size of 4 cloves of garlic)
200g (2%) frozen pollock fillets
10 red chili peppers (not spicy)
10 dried chili peppers (not spicy)
100g coarse gochugaru (for final seasoning)
Business Inquiries: juntvrecipe@gmail.com
#JUNTV #Kimchi #HomemadeKimchi #NoFermentedSeafood #VeganKimchi (optional, depending on pollock) #KoreanFood #KimchiRecipe #HealthyEating #EasyRecipe #DubbedInEnglish #Kimjang

 Avec seulement quelques ingrédients et une heure de salage, vous obtiendrez un kimchi de radis rafraîchissant, pas trop salé, et plein de saveur.
 Je vous montre comment préparer le radis, l’ail, les piments secs et les oignons verts, ainsi que le bon dosage de sel pour une fermentation rapide.

Este guiso de soja fermentada (Cheonggukjang) es muy simple y sabroso — sin anchoas, caldo ni ajo.
 Hecho con champiñones, kimchi, tofu y algunos ingredientes básicos, es más fácil que la sopa de doenjang, pero con un sabor más profundo.
 Sin salsa de pescado ni complicaciones. Solo comodidad y sabor en una sola olla.
 Una vez que lo pruebes, será tu sopa coreana favorita.
 Cocinar es amor.

 180 g de pasta de soja fermentada (cheonggukjang)

 1/4 cebolla
 1 puñado de setas ostra
 100–120 g de tofu
 Sal al gusto

ru.description:

Этот суп из ферментированных соевых бобов (Чхонгукчжан) удивительно прост и насыщен вкусом — без анчоусов, бульона и чеснока.

 Готовка — это любовь.
